svg.title: tsrslint vs tsgolint 7.0.2003
svg.desc: Summed over 8 open-source projects · all 60 rules · 4-vCPU Linux machine. Lint time: tsrslint 19.1 s, tsgolint 92.4 s. Peak memory: tsrslint 11.5 GiB, tsgolint 45.7 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrslint 6.43 s, 2.43 GiB; tsgolint 24.84 s, 10.13 GiB. mui-docs: tsrslint 2.17 s, 1.57 GiB; tsgolint 19.39 s, 8.75 GiB. xstate: tsrslint 0.45 s, 488 MiB; tsgolint 1.46 s, 1.06 GiB. webpack: tsrslint 0.46 s, 457 MiB; tsgolint 1.69 s, 1.07 GiB. cal-diy: tsrslint 1.31 s, 1.26 GiB; tsgolint 6.17 s, 4.34 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrslint 2.65 s, 2.17 GiB; tsgolint 12.01 s, 7.16 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrslint 2.69 s, 1.81 GiB; tsgolint 12.81 s, 6.66 GiB. t3code-server: tsrslint 2.92 s, 1.37 GiB; tsgolint 14.08 s, 6.53 GiB. xstate and webpack are in the release build's PGO training set. Median of 3 interleaved runs. Machine: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 (4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9V45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-16 02:30 UTC; tsrslint commit 62acafda6e48015eddbf57aa1421a47bbc57976a (PGO dist build); stock tsgolint 7.0.2003 (npm @oxlint-tsgolint/linux-x64).
